app.name: Overturn
app.short_description: Every time an agent fixes an AI draft, Overturn keeps it as a replayable case.
app.long_description: Overturn watches the reply box for the AI draft, diffs it against what the agent actually sends, asks for a one-line reason, and records the correction as a case you can replay against any model before you change prompts or models.
app.installation_instructions: Create a project API key in Overturn (Settings → API keys) and paste it into the app settings. Set the workflow name (one regression suite per workflow). Optionally list the custom fields that carry the decision as id:label pairs.
